utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Madam Registrar, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Jadranko Prlic, Bruno Stojic, Slobodan Praljak, Milivoj Petkovic, Valentin Coric and Berislav Pusic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. I'd like to greet all of you here in the courtroom, the Prosecution, the Defence counsel. Everybody is here today, as well as the accused. I take note of the fact that Mr. Pusic is back with us. So everybody is here today. For today's hearing, we have a witness, and as far as I understand, protective measures will be applied for. Mr. Scott, you have the floor.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCOTT
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President, Your Honours. Yes, today's witness will be a closed-session witness. The protective measures were granted by previous court order. The witness will testify in completely closed session with the pseudonym Witness BA.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. We are therefore going to move into closed session, and we'll have to bring down the blinds.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 26th day of September, 2006, at 9:00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.53 p.m.,
